title: Legal Intern
description:
Overview

Job Description We are seeking a motivated Legal Intern to join our Legal Department. This position offers hands-on experience in corporate legal matters while working with experienced professionals in a multinational environment. ABS Legal Interns will work under the supervision of a designated Legal advisor, assisting with legal reviews, research, and day‑to‑day legal activities related to ABS business operations in Brazil and Latin America.

Responsibilities

  • The primary function of a Legal Intern is to develop skills and knowledge of ABS legal and corporate support functions, including but not limited to:
  • Assisting with the review and organization of contracts, NDAs, and legal documents.
  • Supporting legal research on corporate, commercial, labor, and regulatory matters.
  • Interacting with internal departments to gather information and support legal processes.
  • Supporting the Legal team with administrative and compliance‑related tasks.

Qualifications

  • Must be currently pursuing a Bachelor’s Degree in Law at an accredited university (from the 5th semester).
  • Must be a full‑time student and eligible for an internship under Brazilian law.
  • Must be available to work 6 hours per day.
  • Intermediate to advanced English proficiency.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to work collaboratively with different teams.
  • Pro‑active, motivated, and willing to learn.
  • Attention to detail and sense of responsibility.

Reporting Relationships

Report to the local legal counsel.

Note

This job description is not intended to be an all‑inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions. It reflects the principal job elements essential for the purpose of making a fair decision regarding the pay structure of the job.

Equal Opportunity

Equal Opportunity ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non‑work‑related characteristics that may be protected by law.

Notice

Notice ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third‑party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Pl
description:
A área de engenharia de dados é deve garantir que a organização tenha acesso a dados confiáveis e organizados, possibilitando a criação de insights e a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais. Ser um agente de transformação, construindo uma plataforma escalável e resiliente, democratizar o acesso aos dados e impulsionar uma cultura orientada por dados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento, incluindo data lakes e data warehouses, em ambientes em nuvem.
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração.
  • Atuar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e frameworks modernos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas ou pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data viz (Tableau, Power BI e/ou Looker).
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager.
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados.

Conhecimentos Desejáveis

  • Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e Pyspark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados);
  • Data Lakes: Conhecimento de arquiteturas de Data Lake, armazenamento e otimização de dados (ex.: Delta Lake);
  • DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DataOps para automação de deploys e monitoramento de fluxos de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/Composer para integração e movimentação de dados.
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos.
  • APIs: Conhecimento em extração de dados via APIs RESTful.

Competências Técnicas

  • Capacidade de projetar pipelines de dados escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e DevOps para integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Forte habilidade de solucionar problemas complexos de dados com eficiência e criatividade.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Pensamento analítico e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação para traduzir necessidades técnicas e de negócio.
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência para atender demandas críticas.
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e liderança colaborativa.

  • Comunicação Excepcional: Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita para defender o ponto de vista do cliente e traduzir complexidades em mensagens simples e eficazes.

title: Executive Director, Physical Facilities Management
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Executive Director of Physical Facilities Management (PFM) provides strategic leadership and operational oversight of Howard University’s facilities operations and physical assets. Reporting to the Vice President for Capital Planning & Facilities Management, the Executive Director is responsible for directing daily facilities operations, overseeing multimillion-dollar budgets, managing external service contracts, and guiding University-wide space planning. This position ensures that the University’s buildings, infrastructure, and grounds are safe, reliable, efficient, and aligned with Howard’s mission and long-term strategic priorities.

Supervisory Authority

Supervises directors, managers, professional staff, skilled trades, custodial teams, contractors, and other personnel engaged in facilities management and space planning.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include senior leadership, academic deans, and administrative units to ensure facilities operations and space utilization align with institutional priorities. External contacts include architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, utilities, and regulatory agencies to oversee compliance, project execution, and contractual agreements. The role also requires close collaboration with Howard University Hospital and inter‑agency partners, as joint projects and shared facilities work will be prevalent.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provides leadership for daily operations of maintenance, custodial services, grounds, utilities, and building systems, ensuring service quality, responsiveness, and safety.
  • Oversees financial management of PFM operations, including budget development, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost control for operating and capital funds.
  • Administers major vendor and service contracts for custodial, maintenance, utilities, and energy procurement, ensuring performance accountability and fiscal soundness.
  • Directs allocation, planning, and utilization of University building space to support academic, residential, and administrative priorities.
  • Guides preventive and deferred maintenance programs, sustainability initiatives, and capital renewal efforts to extend the life of University assets.
  • Ensures compliance with OSHA, EPA, fire/life safety, and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Establishes key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational efficiency, contractor performance, timeliness and quality of work, and customer satisfaction.
  • Provides strong customer service, fostering collaboration and timely communication across the University with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Serves as the University’s representative in negotiations with external vendors, contractors, and government agencies on facilities‑related matters.
  • Collaborates with Capital Planning & Facilities Management leadership to align space management, renovations, and new construction with institutional priorities.
  • Leads emergency preparedness and disaster recovery planning for facilities operations and infrastructure systems.
  • Contributes to long‑term campus facilities and capital master planning, aligning operational initiatives with the University’s strategic growth and infrastructure needs.
  • Facilitates professional development opportunities for internal and external partners, fostering a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence across the facilities ecosystem.
  • Performs other duties as assigned in support of the University’s mission and campus environment.

Core Competencies

  • Expertise in higher education facilities management, contract negotiation, and budget administration.
  • Strong knowledge of building operations, energy management, and space utilization strategies.
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing large teams, service providers, and complex budgets.
  • Ability to develop long‑term strategies that balance financial sustainability with operational excellence.
  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem‑solving skills with focus on accountability and innovation.
  • Commitment to service quality, timeliness, and the University’s mission.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration, architecture, or related field and eight (8) to ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience in facilities management, contract administration, and budget oversight; or a Master’s degree with five (5) years of directly related experience. Certified Educational Facilities Professional (CEFP) credential from the Association of Physical Plant Administrators (APPA) is strongly preferred, reflecting advanced expertise and commitment to professional excellence in educational facilities management.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $170,000 - $190,000

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Position

Workforce Strategy & Planning

  • Implement the strategic planning and oversight of Workforce Planning & Operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
  • Lead the end-to-end workforce planning process for the delivery of FWWC2027 to cover all workforce types at FIFA27 (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees etc.)
  • Collaborate closely with the FIFA Workforce Management team to develop and manage an integrated workforce planning process, ensuring appropriate and optimized resources to deliver the agreed service levels.
  • Identify & assist with the development of all workforce types and define entitlements for each category.
  • Establish and communicate a centralised headcount plan to serve as the single source of truth for planning and access to data
  • Lead change management processes to support continuity in planning and execution
  • Input into the workforce overall budget, calendar and to the overall workforce strategy

Workforce Operations & Management

  • Deliver and manage the operational plans for all aspects of workforce operations at tournament time, including the design and delivery plan of site operations for workforce
  • Scope all physical operation spaces, overlay, technology and other requirements associated with workforce delivery on site
  • Develop and coordinate business process and scope of requirements for workforce systems to support on site operations at tournament-time
  • Contribute to and deliver the workforce operations role specific and venue specific training
  • Build and manage the schedule for the workforce operations team
  • Collaborate, support and motivate a large team of paid staff and volunteers who will deliver workforce operations on site
  • Collaborate with the wider workforce team on a day-to-day, operational basis
  • Manage logistics and operational requirements at tournament time such as office setup, internal communications, and event-time services (e.g. rewards, certificates, final match celebrations)
  • Coordinate with HR and leadership on sensitive personnel matters
  • Provide guidance and support to workforce operations venue managers at tournament-time
  • Draft and communicate policies and procedures to ensure a consistent and positive workforce experience during events
  • Define workforce service levels and contribute to the development of an entitlement’s matrix

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with cross-functional teams (e.g. Accommodation, Travel, Transport) to prioritise workforce needs
  • Build and maintain strong client focused relationships with all functional areas and work to update and confirm detailed site requirements for all areas.

About World Business Lenders

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides short-term, real estate‑collateralized commercial loans to small and medium‑sized businesses across the United States that do not have access to traditional financing. The company also services its own loan portfolio and those of third parties, with a focus on managing non‑performing loan pools and REO.

WBL is a U.S.‑based company with a fully remote workforce. Working hours are 9:00 am–6:00 pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. The role requires strong spoken and written English. All resumes must be submitted in English.

Establish reliable tracking of all Asset Resolution invoices; improve organization and follow‑up on current invoices so eligible discounts are not missed; support timely movement of invoices through review, correction, and payment readiness; provide strong operational support for aged invoice matters handled by Cristina; improve visibility into invoice status, blockers, and upcoming payment items; and help create a more consistent, disciplined legal billing workflow between Legal Operations, Finance, and outside counsel.

  • Manage legal billing workflow for Asset Resolution matters

  • Strong ability to ensure invoices move through payment cycles on time, including discount deadlines
  • Experience maintaining accurate trackers, records, and status reporting for financial or operational workflows
  • Strong Excel skills and familiarity with workflow tools (e.g., Monday.com or similar systems)
  • Highly organized with strong follow‑through on tasks and escalations

  • Strong communication skills for ongoing follow‑ups and coordination across teams

Preferred Background / Industry Experience

  • Experience in legal billing, legal operations, or law firm billing in a financial services.
  • Candidates coming from law firms, in‑house legal departments, vendor management teams, or finance‑adjacent operational roles with substantial exposure to outside counsel billing and invoice workflow management will be viewed favorably.
  • Experience handling high‑volume invoice tracking, rejected invoice resolution, payment‑cycle coordination, discount‑period monitoring, and support for aged invoice reconciliation is strongly preferred.

Specific Technical Skills Needed

  • Strong proficiency in Excel and Monday.com; experience with invoice tracking, billing reports, document management, and workflow systems; ability to maintain accurate records, monitor discount and payment deadlines, and support billing coordination across Legal, Finance, and AP.

Specific Soft Skills Needed

  • Strong communication

  • Attention to detail and follow‑through
  • Professionalism and cross‑functional collaboration
  • Time management, and problem‑solving

Benefits

  • Garantir a integralidade da atenção por meio da realização de ações de promoção da saúde, prevenção de agravos e curativas;

  • Responsabilizar-se pela população adscrita mantendo a coordenação do cuidado mesmo quando necessita de atenção em outros pontos de atenção do sistema de saúde;
  • Planejar e executar formas de comunicação eficientes com a população em geral;
  • Conhecer a rede de serviços e equipamentos sociais do território, e estimular a atuação intersetorial, com atenção diferenciada para as vulnerabilidades existentes no território;

  • Atender e responder a ouvidorias, nos prazos e fluxos estabelecidos, com objetividade;

  • Avaliar regularmente o desempenho das equipes administrativas e assistenciais, fazendo o uso de ferramentas especiais para este fim;
  • Estabelecer calendário de reuniões com as equipes para avaliação conjunta de resultados;

The Lead CFD & Process Safety Consultant will successfully deliver projects for clients as a member of project teams within a market program. We work across CAPEX and OPEX projects, supporting customers in upstream, midstream, downstream, and emerging sectors such as BESS, CCS, and hydrogen doing advanced technical analysis, practical risk-based engineering judgment, direct client engagement and leadership in project delivery.

  • Flame detector allocation.
  • Exhaust and ventilation dispersion.

  • Flare radiation analysis.
  • Helideck turbulence studies.

  • Develop relationships with existing customers to facilitate the development of new business.

What You Will Need

  • 2-4 years of professional experience is the minimum required.

Desenvolver projetos de engenharia, planejar, orçar e contratar empresas ao conduzir a operação e manutenção de equipamentos médico-hospitalares, visando o funcionamento e bom desempenho dos equipamentos e máquinas, bem como acompanhar a reparação e reposição dos mesmos. title: Integrity Engineer
description:
Location :Rio de Janeiro

ERP Eligibility: ((cust_erp))

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Sumary:

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up‑to‑date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.

title: Especialista Jurídico Sênior
description:
Contexte et environnement

A posição atua no mercado brasileiro, caracterizado por um ambiente jurídico e regulatório complexo e em constante evolução. O cargo exige interação e colaboração frequentes com uma ampla gama de partes internas e externas, incluindo clientes internos, escritórios de advocacia, associações do setor, parceiros de joint ventures, fornecedores e autoridades governamentais. Dada a natureza dessas interações, a função demanda fortes habilidades de negociação e a capacidade de se engajar de forma estratégica e eficaz com diferentes públicos.

Activités

O(a) funcionário(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à proteção da integridade das pessoas, tendo em vista a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e para a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.

Principais Atividades

  • Assessoria Jurídica Estratégica: Prestar assessoria jurídica e regulatória estratégica aos clientes internos, como equipes de Joint Ventures (JVs), em matérias administrativas, societárias, ambientais, cíveis, regulatórias de E&P e contenciosas.
  • Elaboração e Negociação Contratual: Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos comerciais, societários e operacionais relevantes, assegurando alinhamento com os modelos da TTE (quando aplicável), com os requisitos legais e com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Suporte à Governança de JVs: Apoiar as joint ventures em processos de governança, identificando riscos jurídicos, propondo medidas de mitigação e garantindo a conformidade ao longo do ciclo de vida dos projetos.
  • Relacionamento com Stakeholders e Autoridades: Atuar junto a partes externas, como autoridades governamentais, parceiros de joint ventures e associações do setor, apoiando o posicionamento jurídico da companhia e protegendo seus direitos e obrigações.
  • Resolução de Conflitos: Recomendar e implementar estratégias e conduzir processos de resolução de disputas, incluindo arbitragens de alto valor, processos administrativos e judiciais, assegurando estratégia coerente, adequada avaliação de riscos e coordenação eficaz com escritórios externos.
  • Monitoramento Legal e Regulatório e Avaliação de Impactos no Negócio: Monitorar evoluções legais e regulatórias que impactem as atividades de E&P e assessorar o negócio quanto a impactos, riscos e medidas de implementação necessárias.
  • Coordenação de Escritórios Externos: Coordenar as atividades com escritórios de advocacia externos e especialistas, garantindo consistência estratégica e alto padrão de entregáveis.
  • Representação e Atuação Institucional: Representar a companhia em comitês externos (ex.: IBP) e organizações do setor, liderando iniciativas de advocacy em matérias jurídicas e regulatórias e protegendo os ativos, a reputação e a licença social para operar no longo prazo.
  • Reporte à Gestão: Reportar de forma consistente e buscar orientação da gestão em assuntos que envolvam elevada exposição financeira ou impacto reputacional.
  • One Maestro: Atuar em conformidade com os princípios de HSSSE e One Maestro, visando proteger os ativos, a reputação e a licença de longo prazo para operar da companhia.

Responsabilités

O Especialista Jurídico Sênior prestará suporte a outras divisões da TEPBR, conforme alocação definida pelo Gerente Jurídico e pelo Diretor de Jurídico, Assuntos Regulatórios e Governança Corporativa, bem como elaborará análises sobre temas regulatórios e jurídicos de média-alta complexidade e materialidade, relacionados a atividades, ativos e projetos especiais. O cargo também apoiará a implementação e a observância das regras e regulamentos de Compliance e de HSE aplicáveis. O(a) empregado(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro, com foco na proteção da integridade das pessoas, preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.

Profil du candidat

Nível de qualificação: Bacharelado em Direito, com registro ativo na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB). Experiência jurídica em nível sênior, com sólido conhecimento do arcabouço regulatório brasileiro e da prática internacional, especialmente em Leis do Petróleo e regulamentações da ANP. Experiência em estruturas contratuais sofisticadas de E&P é um diferencial, incluindo estruturas complexas de governança em múltiplos regimes jurídicos (PSC, Concessão), unitizações, redeterminações, bem como contratos de serviços técnicos (EPCIs e outros).

Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação: excelente comunicação verbal e habilidade de redação.

  • Ética: elevados padrões éticos.

Experiência profissional

Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.

This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Marketing Engineer - a new kind of role built for the AI era. This isn't a traditional content manager or social media coordinator. You are a one-person growth machine who uses AI tools as your force multiplier. You will own organic growth across all DM brands: social media, SEO, blog, and founder personal brands - executing at a volume and quality that would previously require a full team.

This role was created because the future of marketing belongs to individuals who know how to direct AI — not just use it. If you've been quietly building a content or automation operation powered by AI tools, this was designed for you.

  • Genuine interest in crypto, DeFi, or Web3 - you don't need to be a technical expert, but you need to care about the space

Strong Advantages

  • Familiarity with tools like Buffer, Notion, Ahrefs/SEMrush, Canva, or CapCut
  • Experience supporting personal brand building for executives or founders

Benefits

A Globoé feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

O maior portal do Brasil vai ganhar, enfim, seu próprio perfil nas redes sociais. Teremos como desafio ampliar a presença da marca Globo.com nas plataformas, gerando awareness e tráfego para o nosso site, produtos e parceiros. Por se tratar de um portal "agregador", você irá se deparar com os mais diversos tipos de conteúdos e formatos. Queremos justamente que essa ampla variedade se traduza nas redes, carregando para as plataformas a credibilidade e padrão de qualidade encontrados em nossa já consolidada home-page.

  • Planejar, estruturar e evoluir calendários editoriais, priorizando temas, formatos e oportunidades de acordo com objetivos estratégicos;
  • Atuar de forma próxima a diferentes áreas e parceiros, liderando alinhamentos e garantindo consistência na execução de projetos e iniciativas;
  • Orientar e apoiar profissionais de níveis iniciais, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento do time e a qualidade das entregas;
  • Acompanhar tendências de redes sociais, comportamento de audiência e movimentos de mercado, traduzindo aprendizados em aplicações práticas e direcionamentos editoriais;
  • Atuar com alto senso crítico, responsabilidade editorial e visão de marca, garantindo aderência às políticas institucionais, legais e aos princípios da Globo;
  • Atuar com uma visão jornalística, transformando curadoria em conteúdo de prático consumo do público geral nas redes sociais.

title: Coordenador (a) de Transporte
description:
A Clubbi é um marketplace B2B para pequenos mercados de bairro. Fornecemos uma nova forma de abastecer a loja: mais conveniente, aos melhores preços e com os melhores prazos de entrega.

Nossa visão é otimizar toda a cadeia de suprimentos e operações para este segmento do varejo, que representa um mercado de R$250Bi somente no Brasil.

A Clubbi foi fundada em 2020 e já chamou atenção de alguns dos melhores fundos de VC do Brasil e do Vale do Silício: Valor Capital, OneVC, Canary, Better Tomorrow Ventures.

Em 2022, recebemos a rodada Series A, liderada por Hi Ventures e Nfx.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Nossa missão é fortalecer os pequenos varejistas como os maiores protagonistas do comércio na América Latina.

A gente acredita que por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para estes produtos.

Para ter sucesso neste objetivo, desenvolvemos uma cultura única e especial:

  • Nos desprendemos da nossa realidade para vestir a camisa pelo nosso cliente;
  • Desenvolvemos um time fora da curva;
  • Não temos medo de errar, desde que isso nos ensine alguma coisa;
  • Temos foco e somos obcecados por priorização e eficiência;
  • Tratamos adultos como adultos, com autonomia e responsabilidade;
  • Somos transparentes e não-hierárquicos;
  • Nos preocupamos genuinamente com as nossas pessoas;
  • Cuidamos para que a Clubbi seja um local incrível para trabalhar;
  • Acreditamos que um ambiente de excelência, aprendizado rápido, foco obsessivo no cliente junto com muita colaboração e diversão permite a todos alcançar o seu potencial pleno e contribuir com nossa missão.

Missão do Cargo

Num contexto de forte crescimento das vendas, gerenciar nossa frota agregada, assegurando profissionalismo, eficiência e disponibilidade dos motoristas.

A área de transporte tem um papel essencial dentro da Clubbi, impactando a experiência dos nossos clientes no momento da entrega, e garantindo nosso crescimento por meio da captação e desenvolvimento de novos motoristas.

A área de transporte também é responsável pelo transporte first mile, dos nossos fornecedores até o nosso armazém.

Principais Responsabilidades

Gestão de transportadores (First Mile)

  • Gerenciar e acompanhar transportadores responsáveis pelas coletas e transferências iniciais da operação.
  • Garantir cumprimento de prazos, qualidade do serviço e aderência aos padrões operacionais.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho e implementar melhorias na operação.
  • Procurar soluções de redução de custo nas coletas.

Gestão da frota agregada

  • Gerenciar uma frota de aproximadamente 60 motoristas agregados.
  • Acompanhar desempenho operacional, pontualidade e qualidade das entregas.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com os motoristas para garantir engajamento e retenção.
  • Em colaboração com nossa área de Customer Experience & Tracking, garantir o bom andamento das entregas.

Captação e treinamento de motoristas

  • Em colaboração com a área de planejamento, identificar necessidade de captação e adequação da nossa frota.
  • Conduzir processos de recrutamento e integração de novos motoristas conforme o crescimento da empresa.
  • Organizar treinamentos operacionais e garantir o alinhamento às práticas e processos da empresa.

Gestão administrativa da operação

  • Validar e acompanhar pagamentos aos motoristas e transportadores.

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
MSF has worked in Brazil for over 30 years in a context of deep social inequalities and unequal access to healthcare. Since 2018, MSF Operational Centre Brussels (OCB) has implemented direct operations, initially supporting migrants and refugees, and later expanding to Indigenous health, emergency response, and public health.

In 2026, the programme focuses on the Rio de Janeiro Tuberculosis Prison Project, improving access to TB care for people deprived of liberty, while maintaining engagement in emergency preparedness, advocacy, and institutional collaboration with MSF Brazil and regional referents.

The programme operates within a shared institutional setup with MSF Brazil and Cell 5 (Latin America & Caribbean), requiring strong coordination and compliance with OCB standards. To support this environment, MSF OCB is recruiting a Human Resources Coordinator (HRCo).

As HRCo , you oversee HR strategy and policy implementation across the programme, ensure alignment with operational needs and OCB standards, act as a strategic partner to operations, and are fully accountable for MSF’s employer responsibilities, including legal and compliance matters.

Responsibilities

1. Strategic HR Leadership & Workforce Planning

  • Translate programme priorities (TB Prison Project, emergency preparedness, advocacy) into short-, mid-, and long-term workforce strategies.
  • Adapt the Coordination Team structure to a single-project programme, clarifying roles, reporting lines, and decision‑making.
  • Ensure HR systems support the transition from multiple projects (Marajó, Yanomami) to Rio TB Prison Project.
  • Anticipate emergency and future staffing needs through scenario planning, surge mechanisms, and training plans.

2. Recruitment, Matching & Talent Management

  • Define HR needs and coordinate recruitment and IMS matching in compliance with Brazilian labour law (CLT) and OCB policies.
  • Manage a diverse workforce (country‑based and mobile staff), including operational constraints such as Portuguese language requirements.
  • Analyse the labour market, define recruitment strategies, and identify effective sourcing channels.
  • Maintain an emergency pool to ensure rapid mobilisation capacity.
  • Promote internal and interprogramme mobility through a programme‑specific mobility approach aligned with MSF standards.

3. Governance, Compliance & Institutional Coordination

  • Ensure coherent HR governance within a shared institutional setup (OCB, MSF Brazil, Cell 5).
  • Coordinate closely with MSF Brazil on legal matters, audits, payroll, benefits, HR systems, and outsourced services.
  • Ensure full compliance of HR policies, contracts, and procedures with Brazilian legislation and MSF standards.
  • Guarantee accurate documentation, HR data quality, system use, monthly closing, and HR reporting.
  • Define, adapt, and implement local HR policies, SOPs, and guidelines in line with MSF frameworks.
  • Oversee induction, training, performance management (PMS), and career development.
  • Identify training and development needs, including high‑potential staff, aligned with future programme priorities.
  • Integrate safeguarding, behaviour & ethics, and diversity & inclusion across the HR lifecycle.
  • Define and coordinate a fair, competitive, and compliant reward policy.

5. Support Operations & People Management

  • Provide HR analysis and workforce planning for the TB Prison Project, including scale‑up and technical specialisation.
  • Ensure HR operational support during emergencies (recruitment, deployment, contracts, health and safety, administration).
  • Advise on HR aspects of advocacy initiatives, including contractual and legal considerations.
  • Coach managers on people management, communication, conflict management, and stress prevention.
  • Prevent, detect, and manage conflicts and behavioural issues.

6. Team Leadership, Administration & Duty of Care

  • Act as programme‑level HR and Administration technical referent.
  • Line‑manage the HR and administration team.
  • Ensure structured staff lifecycle processes (briefings, induction, end of assignment, debriefing, knowledge capitalisation).
  • Ensure safe, healthy, and compliant working conditions in coordination with medical and logistics teams.

7. Coordination, Representation & Strategic Contribution

  • Contribute actively to Country Coordination Team decision‑making and strategic planning.
  • Plan, monitor, and report on HR operational and budgetary needs.
  • Report on HR indicators to support programme adjustments and strategic decisions.
  • Represent MSF with authorities and external stakeholders on HR and administrative matters.
  • Contribute to the long‑term alignment and harmonisation of practices between OCB and MSF Brazil.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Degree in HR management or related administrative studies is mandatory.
  • Minimum 3 years of HR management experience with MSF or a similar INGO is mandatory.
  • Minimum 6 months of international MSF experience as HR Coordinator is mandatory.
  • Experience in mediation and conflict management is mandatory.
  • Experience in training, coaching, mentoring, and team supervision is mandatory.
  • Experience in emergency contexts is an asset.
  • Knowledge of the Brazilian legal framework is an asset.
  • Knowledge of MSF OCB internal HR tools is an asset.

Languages

  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese , both written & spoken is mandatory.

Conditions

  • Expected starting date: As soon as possible.
  • Location: based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
  • Salary according to MSF salary grid.
  • The contractual terms, conditions and salary will be established according to the official residence of the selected candidate (mobile staff contract if not resident in Brazil, local contract otherwise).
  • Family position possible.

MSF values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of disability, gender identity, marital or civil partnership status, race, color or ethnic and national origins, religion or belief, or sexual orientation.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Job description

Hostess, Garçom, Cumim, Cozinheiro... Sua vaga está no nosso radar!

Você é o coração da operação. É a sua energia que faz com que cada cliente tenha uma experiência inesquecível no Grupo FIT.

Se você trabalha na operação do restaurante , seja como Hostess, Garçom, Cumim, Cozinheiro, ou em outras posições do time , e tem o perfil para fazer a operação acontecer com agilidade, foco no cliente e espírito de equipe, queremos você no nosso time!

Esta não é uma vaga para uma posição específica, mas a sua chance de se conectar com a gente. Ao se cadastrar no nosso Banco de Talentos para Operações , você garante um lugar em nosso time para futuras oportunidades.

Main responsibilities

Nossos papéis na Operação

Nossa equipe é a essência do nosso negócio. É nela que garantimos o atendimento de excelência, a agilidade no serviço e o ambiente acolhedor. As posições que mantêm nossa operação funcionando são:

  • Hostess: A primeira impressão do cliente. Você irá recebê-lo com cordialidade e organizará o fluxo de mesas, garantindo uma recepção calorosa e ágil.
  • Garçom: O elo com o cliente. Você será responsável por servir mesas, apresentar o cardápio e garantir que os pedidos sejam entregues com precisão e simpatia.
  • Cumim: O braço direito do salão. Você será responsável por dar suporte aos garçons, ajudando na limpeza das mesas, na organização do salão e no transporte dos pedidos.
  • Cozinheiro: O artista principal da cozinha quente. Você será responsável por executar e preparar os pratos do cardápio principal, seguindo as receitas e os padrões de qualidade e higiene da empresa.
  • Auxiliar de Cozinha: O suporte essencial para a equipe da cozinha. Você será responsável por auxiliar no pré-preparo dos ingredientes, na organização do espaço e na limpeza, garantindo que tudo flua com perfeição para o time de cozinheiros.

title: Supervisor Manutenção Industrial (Automação)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você busca desafios? Venha fazer parte de nosso time!

Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar dentro de um dos nossos negócios na Wickbold, que faz parte do Grupo Bimbo, a maior empresa de panificação do mundo. Estamos presentes em 39 países, distribuídos em quatro continentes: América, Europa, África e Ásia. Fabricamos mais de 13.000 produtos diferentes, atuando em categorias como pães, doces, snacks e torradas, levando qualidade, inovação e sabor a milhões de consumidores diariamente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Quais os seus desafios?

  • Supervisionar e planejar as atividades de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva de máquinas, equipamentos e sistemas de utilidades, assegurando a disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos ativos.
  • Organizar e gerenciar recursos necessários à execução das atividades, incluindo mão de obra, peças, materiais, ferramentas, treinamentos e serviços terceiros.
  • Definir prioridades de manutenção da planta fabril, alinhando as demandas com as necessidades operacionais e de produção.
  • Acompanhar a execução das atividades de manutenção, incluindo desmontagem, montagem e intervenções técnicas, garantindo qualidade e segurança.
  • Atuar na análise de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas, aumento de produtividade e redução de falhas.
  • Desenvolver estudos técnicos e elaborar projetos voltados à modernização de equipamentos e otimização de processos.
  • Supervisionar as equipes de elétrica, automação, utilidades e apoio mecânico, garantindo o atendimento às linhas de produção e a execução das inspeções nos equipamentos.
  • Distribuir e orientar as atividades da equipe conforme prioridade e programação de ordens de serviço, assegurando o cumprimento das metas operacionais.
  • Atuar na gestão de pessoas, incluindo seleção, treinamento, desenvolvimento e avaliação de desempenho da equipe.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança do trabalho, meio ambiente e sistema de gestão, promovendo uma cultura de segurança.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos serviços executados, mantendo-os alinhados aos padrões e procedimentos da empresa.
  • Trabalhar com foco em resultados, promovendo integração e colaboração entre as áreas.
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar indicadores de manutenção, planos de manutenção e desempenho dos sistemas de utilidades.
  • Atuar na gestão dos ativos da planta, garantindo o acompanhamento do desempenho, confiabilidade e ciclo de vida dos equipamentos, apoiando decisões de manutenção, substituição e melhoria, com foco na disponibilidade, segurança e eficiência operacional.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você?

  • Graduação em Engenharia Industrial ou áreas relacionadas à manutenção ou operações.
  • Habilidades de liderança, comunicação, organização, planejamento e resolução de problemas.
  • Olhar para segurança, qualidade e excelência operacional.

Informações adicionais

O que a Wickbold oferece para você:

  • Salário compatível com o Mercado;
  • Restaurante Interno;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência médica e odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Estacionamento;
  • Convênio Pet;
  • Totalpass;
  • PLR;
  • Ticket em datas especiais;
  • Desconto em nossa loja de fábrica;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e escolas de idiomas;
  • Ações de desenvolvimentos profissional;
  • Políticas e ações afirmativas de diversidade e inclusão.

Na Wickbold, acreditamos na Diversidade & Inclusão! Dessa forma, não admitimos qualquer atitude de preconceito ou discriminação relacionada a gênero, condição sexual, idade, cor, religião, estado civil, raça, crença ou filosofia de vida, ideologia política, deficiência física, mental ou auditiva, convicção, origem social, situação familiar ou necessidade especial, entre outras, nas nossas aplicações, são consideradas apenas a capacidade técnica, a experiência profissional e o perfil aderente às necessidades do cargo. Por isso, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Anfitrião de Hospedagem - Hotelaria - Barra - RJ (Escala: 6x1)
description:
Objetivo do Cargo

Receber e atender os clientes conforme o estilo da marca de atuação. Prestar informações diversas, de acordo com as necessidades dos clientes e práticas essenciais da área. Colocar os clientes no "coração" de tudo que for realizado, a fim de oferecer a eles uma experiência única e inesquecível, em alinhamento com a Cultura de serviços bUP hotels.

Atividades

  • Efetuar reservas solicitadas, consultando o sistema quanto à disponibilidade.
  • Informar ao cliente todos os dados, tais como: valor da diária, tipo de apartamento, horários etc.
  • Ser responsável pelo e-mail de reservas do hotel, respondendo às dúvidas de clientes e confirmando as reservas solicitadas por esse meio.
  • Recepcionar os clientes conforme o estilo da marca de atuação. Ser um facilitador de serviços, prestando informações quanto ao funcionamento básico do hotel.
  • Verificar a reserva, solicitar o preenchimento dos dados pessoais na FNRH (quando for necessário) e conferir documentos requeridos. Garantir o cumprimento da lei de hospedagem de menor e efetuar a entrega da chave do apartamento.
  • Ser o principal interlocutor entre o cliente e outras áreas do hotel, recebendo suas solicitações, sugestões, reclamações, etc. Buscar a resolução, repassando essas informações ao departamento responsável.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre todas as informações da cidade relativas a entretenimento, eventos locais etc. Oferecer e pontuar o programa de fidelidade de acordo com as orientações.
  • Atender o telefone conforme o estilo da marca de atuação.
  • Realizar o despertar dos hóspedes quando solicitado.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das práticas da Recepção e procedimentos do Autocontrole.
  • Atender os clientes no restaurante/bar/loja de conveniência do hotel, caso seja necessário, em favor do espírito de polivalência.
  • Controlar a disponibilidade dos apartamentos da unidade junto ao sistema de distribuição (TARS, Omnibees, ou outros sistemas, caso aplicável), considerando a realidade do hotel. Evitar discrepâncias entre as reservas e os apartamentos ocupados.
  • Verificar e organizar os documentos após check out, para envio da fatura com a nota fiscal ao cliente.
  • Ser responsável e zelar pela guarda de todo o recebimento (dinheiro e cartões de crédito). Fazer o controle do fluxo de caixa e garantir que não ocorram discrepâncias.
  • Verificar saldos em aberto e contas pendentes.
  • Estar atento e zelar pela manutenção e organização da recepção e back office, livros de controle e materiais de escritório.
  • Ser embaixador dos Valores das marcas e participar ativamente das ações de animação da Cultura de Serviços.

Escolaridade

Superior em Turismo / Hotelaria ou em áreas correlatas (Completo ou Cursando).

Conhecimentos Específicos

Atendimento ao Cliente e Atendimento Telefônico.

Sistemas / Informática

title: Analista de Excelência Operacional - SR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Quem Somos

Somos um time que cuida da limpeza do seu lar gerando bem-estar, no qual combinamos determinação e comprometimento para entregarmos produtos de qualidade.

Entendemos que para obter os melhores resultados, precisamos dos melhores profissionais.

Estamos à procura de talentos que sejam criativos, inovadores e ousados na busca por conhecimento, que tragam resultados sustentáveis ao Grupo Limppano

Se você tem prazer em contribuir, gosta do que faz e é focado em resultados, essa VAGA é para VOCÊ

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Missão: Estruturar e sustentar o sistema de gestão de performance operacional (processos, indicadores e melhoria contínua), garantindo execução de iniciativas e captura de valor em custo, serviço, produtividade e capital.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Mapear processos ponta a ponta e definir padrões operacionais, SLAs e controles de rotina.
  • Estruturar e manter governança de KPIs (definições, fontes, consistência) e dashboards industriais e logísticos.
  • Conduzir rituais de performance (DMS) e gestão de planos de ação, com escalonamento e acompanhamento de prazos.
  • Liderar projetos de melhoria contínua (Lean/DMAIC), realizando análise de causa-raiz e implantando soluções com plano de controle.
  • Medir perdas e oportunidades (OEE, refugo, retrabalho, avarias, OTIF, produtividade, custo logístico) e propor iniciativas.
  • Mensurar ganhos benefits tracking (baseline, metas, ganhos) em parceria com Finanças e Operações: CAPEX desprendido + OPEX incremental à Payback e ROI de projetos.
  • Capacitar times operacionais em ferramentas e rotinas (PDCA, 5W2H, Ishikawa, VSM, 5S) e apoiar gestão da mudança.
  • Atuar como ponte entre Operações, Logística e Finanças para priorização e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Para você fazer parte do nosso Grupo de talentos, você precisa ter:

  • Formação: Engenharia e correlatas (preferencialmente, Eng. Mecânica, Química, Produção ou Adm.)
  • Domínio de indicadores operacionais (OEE, OTIF, produtividade, perdas, inventário).
  • Excel/Power BI (ou similar) para análise e automação de relatórios.
  • Vivência em Lean/Six Sigma (desejável Green Belt).
  • Experiência em indústria e/ou logística com foco em performance e processos.
  • Atuar de 100% presencial em nossas unidades de negócio (Botafogo, Pavuna e Queimados).

Indicadores de sucesso (exemplos)

  • Redução de perdas (refugo, retrabalho, avarias, urgências/fretes extras).
  • Aumento de produtividade e eficiência (OEE, unidades/hora, picking/hora).
  • Melhoria de nível de serviço (OTIF, lead time, backlog).
  • Aderência a padrão e disciplina de rotina (reuniões, planos de ação, SLA de dados).
  • Ganhos validados (R$) e sustentados (control plan).

As a Sales Executive at RX, you will not simply be selling square meters or booth spaces. Your mission is to sell growth opportunities. In a market where face-to-face connection is the most valuable asset, you will act as the architect who connects major brands with their target audiences, transforming the exhibition hall into a business ecosystem.

  • High-Level Networking: Act as an ambassador for the event, building relationships with decision-makers (C-level executives and Marketing/Sales Directors).

  • Proven track record in B2B sales (preferably in events, advertising, media, or the construction industry).

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus.
  • Ability to collaborate with colleagues to generate cross-selling opportunities.

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits.

Description

Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organizationally to the FIFA27 Senior Competition Manager, the Competition Coordinator will be a key member of the FIFA27 Competition Management (CPM) team. Working closely with and under the guidance of the FIFA Competition Management project team, the role is responsible for delivering the highest standards of competition, tournament and match operations in Brazil before and during the FWWC27, as well as for FIFA test events and other relevant tournaments and events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure that competition area and venue readiness are implemented in line with FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines, under the guidance of FIFA Competition Management, the Senior Competition Manager and the Competition Manager.
  • Support the planning, training, administration and integration of the locally based Competition Management team.
  • Together with the Senior Competition Manager and the Competition Manager, oversee the successful operational delivery of Competition Management activities before and during the FWWC27.
  • Represent Competition Management at key meetings, inspections and operational forums as required.
  • Collating feedback and building presentations based on strategic meetings and site inspections.
  • Plan and deliver competition-related events, workshops and seminars in collaboration with FIFA Zurich (including test events and official FIFA workshops).
  • Monitor competition areas during venue construction or refurbishment to ensure compliance with FIFA standards and follow up on all related requirements.
  • Plan and deliver stadium and competition readiness exercises, including development of operational documentation and materials.
  • Oversee team and stadium equipment requirements (e.g. team materials, field of play equipment), including procurement coordination, delivery and confirmation.
  • Preparing reports and presentations on Competition Management key matters.
  • Support the recruitment, training and coordination of Competition Management volunteers.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor's degree in Sports Management or Event Management (master’s degree is an asset).
  • Minimum 2 (two) years of experience in football and event management; international experience is preferred.
  • At least 1 (one) year of experience in Competition Management (football and match operations).
  • Strong knowledge of international football.
  • Proven experience in competition and match operations, as well as sports venue operations.
  • Solid understanding of event planning, project management, and logistics processes.
  • Knowledge of the local culture and operational environment in Brazil is an advantage.
  • Strong administrative and IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Ability to monitor performance and implement decisive corrective actions.
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain highly qualified employees.
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, negotiation and relationship-management skills, with high energy and a proactive mindset.
  • Ability to prioritize and handle large workload efficiently at peak times.
  • Ability to work under pressure and stress.
  • Sound judgement and prioritization of tasks.
  • Experience of managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas.
  • Team Player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Ability to work effectively in an international, dynamic and demanding environment.
  • Ability to adapt and work with people from different cultures and backgrounds.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken); any additional language skills (in particular Spanish and French) are an asset.

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: HSS and Signalling Engineer - São Paulo/Rio de Janeiro Based
description:
Overview

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. The company operates a fully regulated telecommunications platform across 40 countries worldwide, including its own global mobile core network, in-house eSIM technology, and a broad portfolio of telecom licenses.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast-moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund growth and continue investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion.

Founded in 2022 by technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in 28 additional markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Signalling functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analyzing and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the signalling routing area and subscriber data management systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes for the existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support other functional areas in cross-functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLDs, LLDs, WOs, etc.) and maintaining it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environments. Understanding of end-to-end system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers and service providers
  • Elaborate and manage the process for change requests to current partners to meet network needs
  • Control the network elements roadmap, responsible for necessary software/hardware upgrades during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including cross-team processes
  • Document the existing technology portfolio and propose recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

Must-haves

  • Proven experience in implementing live mobile telecom solutions (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), network design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of signalling network functions, including STPs, DEA/DRAs and HLR/HSS
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining signalling interconnects (SIGTRAN and DIAMETER) using SCTP multi-homing
  • Experience with HLR/HSS, subscriber profiles, subscriber repositories and reference interfaces
  • Knowledge of IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes, including Application Servers and its interaction with profile repositories
  • Experience in mobile services charging (online). Knowledge and experience with Ro, Gy, Gx interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with signalling protocols and routing including M3UA, M2PA, DIAMETER, as well as upper layer protocols such as MAP, CAMEL, Sh, Cx
  • Knowledge of 5G SA networks from a signalling (SCP and SEPP) and AUSF/UDM/UDR perspective
  • Experience with protocol analyser tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architectures and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory; other languages are a plus

Sua jornada na A&M

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. Nosso robusto processo de desenvolvimento de desempenho promove o aprendizado contínuo, recompensa suas contribuições e cultiva uma cultura de meritocracia. Com treinamentos de alta qualidade e oportunidades de aprendizado prático, você pode adquirir novas habilidades e avançar em sua carreira.

Priorizamos o seu bem-estar, oferecendo benefícios e recursos para apoiar sua jornada pessoal. Nossos colaboradores destacam constantemente as oportunidades de crescimento, nossa cultura empreendedora única e a diversão que vivenciamos juntos como os aspectos favoritos de trabalhar na A&M. As possibilidades são infinitas para profissionais de alto desempenho e paixão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Diversidade Inclusiva significa que abraçamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão, incentivando todos a trazerem seu Âu completo para o trabalho a cada dia. Isso permeia a maneira como recrutamos, desenvolvemos os colaboradores, conduzimos os negócios, apoiamos os clientes e fazemos parcerias com fornecedores. É a forma A&M de ser.

É prática da Alvarez & Marsal fornecer e promover oportunidades iguais em emprego, compensação e outras condições de trabalho, sem discriminação por raça, cor, credo, religião, origem nacional, ascendência, status de cidadania, sexo ou gênero, identidade de gênero ou expressão de gênero (incluindo status de pessoa transgênero), orientação sexual, estado civil, serviço militar e status de veterano, deficiência física ou mental, histórico médico familiar, informações genéticas ou qualquer outra condição médica protegida, afiliação política ou qualquer outra característica protegida por e em conformidade com as leis aplicáveis. Colaboradores e Candidatos podem encontrar as declarações de política da A&M e informações adicionais por região aqui.

Reporting organizationally to the FIFA27 Senior Competition Manager, the Competition Coordinator will be a key member of the FIFA27 Competition Management (CPM) team.   • Ensure that competition area and venue readiness are implemented in line with FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines, under the guidance of FIFA Competition Management, the Senior Competition Manager and the Competition Manager.

  • Oversee team and stadium equipment requirements (e.g., team materials, field of play equipment), including procurement coordination, delivery and confirmation.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Sports Management or Event Management (master’s degree is an asset).

title: Manager, Access Management Cluster
description:
Manager, Access Management Cluster

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN´S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brazil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures.

Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well‑planned ingress, circulation & egress.

The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament.

You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites.
  • Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution.
  • Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings.
  • Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues.
  • Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions.
  • Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them.

Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar.
  • If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.
  • Football access management knowledge.
  • FIFA access management knowledge is a plus.
  • Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.
  • Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

Experience

  • Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage.
  • Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation.
  • Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment.
  • Single‑sport, multi‑venue event experience.
  • Management and leadership of a team in high‑pressure tournament operations.
  • Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

This position is to work on a hybrid schedule in our office in Rio de Janeiro.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed in a timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and in a timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIs.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work‑life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires).
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work. We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

title: Tech Lead Analyst, Software Engineering and Data Science (Open to Internal and External applicants)
description:
Overview

Tiered Approach In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Job Description

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

UNDP provides integrated programmatic, policy and financing solutions to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). In this context, UNDP has created a Global Policy Network (GPN), a network of field-based and global technical expertise across a wide range of knowledge domains and in support of the signature solutions and organizational capabilities envisioned in the Strategic Plan. The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) and the Crisis Bureau (CB) are the two anchor Bureaux of the GPN.

In this context, the newly established Governance, Rule of Law, and Peacebuilding (GRP) Hub, a joint endeavor with the Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS), provides leadership and advisory services to enhance UNDP’s impact on governance and peacebuilding, ensuring the integration of democratic governance and human rights into crisis response and recovery.

Through Local Action, the GRP Hub seeks to contribute to peace and development, achieving a visible impact on communities and improving lives by delivering integrated solutions that harness global expertise and partnerships. The Local Action Unit works closely with local and regional governments as key development players, highlighting their role as public service implementers, as drivers of innovation and the closest institution to people.

Local and regional governments are already responsible for over 65% of the SDG targets, most of them linked to basic service provision from water, sanitation, mobility, climate action, health or education. Cities and territories are playing a big part in the implementation of SDGs, becoming a tool for strategic planning and budgeting in the mid to long term. Since 2015, local governments and their associations have been active in promoting the SDGs through advocacy, working with their local population and partners in transposing the spirit of Agenda 2030 in cities and territories. Local Governments have also started to use SDGs as a framework to deliver better public services linked to SDG targets and indicators. As part of the SDG Local Action project, UNDP is one of the implementing partners of the Mayors Challenge, a global initiative to reimagine essential services that cities deliver to residents.

Duties And Responsibilities

Under the overall supervision of the Project Manager and in close coordination with IplanRio, relevant municipal technical teams, and UNDP, the Tech Lead Analyst, Software Engineering and Data Science will perform the following functions:

  • Lead data engineering and integration
