Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM se consolidou como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução, atuando em diferentes frentes e adaptando-se continuamente às transformações do mercado.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

A Community Health Worker (CHW) serves as a trusted liaison between healthcare providers, social services, and the community. The CHW supports individuals and families by providing health education, connecting them with resources, promoting wellness, and helping reduce barriers to care.

Supervisory Accountability

None

Nature And Scope

Community settings, clinics, nonprofit organizations, or public health departments. May include outreach events, and occasional evenings/weekends. Responsible for advocacy and problem‑solving, health education and communication, and collaboration and teamwork.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provide culturally appropriate health education and outreach.
  • Connect clients with medical, behavioral health, and social service resources.
  • Assist individuals with care coordination and follow‑up appointments.
  • Conduct community outreach.
  • Help clients navigate healthcare systems and insurance processes.
  • Advocate for community needs and support health equity initiatives.
  • Document client interactions and maintain accurate records.
  • Participate in case conferences and interdisciplinary team meetings.
  • Support chronic disease management.
  • Basic computer skills in operating systems, internet & email proficiency, Word, Excel, file management, create documents, organize files and solve simple problems related to the computer and smartphone technology.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of community resources and local populations.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to build trust with diverse communities.
  • Basic computer and documentation skills.

Minimum Requirements

High school diploma or GED (associate or bachelor’s degree in public health, social work, or related field preferred).

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Part Time - $24.04 hourly.

  • Apoio Logístico e Controle de Estoque: Conferir notas fiscais no recebimento de produtos, realizar e apoiar inventários, controlar perdas e garantir acuracidade do estoque.
  • Atendimento na Entrega de Produtos: Conferir, testar produtos com o cliente e auxiliar no transporte até o veículo, assegurando atendimento personalizado.
  • Armazenamento e Organização de Estoque: Organizar produtos e insumos no estoque conforme POPs, garantindo controle e integridade dos itens.

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência desejável em atendimento ao cliente, operações de estoque, caixa e atividades administrativas de loja.
  • Habilidade com a ferramenta Excel e sistemas.

  • Capacidade de comunicação eficaz e proatividade no atendimento aos clientes.
  • Disponibilidade para horários flexíveis, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.

Remuneração: Oferecemos um salário competitivo, compatível com as práticas de mercado.

Horário de Trabalho: Escala 6x1, com atuação de segunda a sábado, das 13h24 às 22h00, e aos domingos e feriados, das 14h00 às 20h00.

Programa QualiFast: Nosso programa de saúde e bem‑estar oferece atendimento nutricional, psicológico (com sessões de psicoterapia via Wellz), atendimento social, acompanhamento de internações, atenção primária à saúde (APS), programa especial para gestantes (Primeiros Passos) e educação financeira por meio do Saber Financeiro.

title: Offshore Logistics Coordinator
description:
Overview

Airswift is looking for an Offshore Logistics Coordinator (12 months) to work in a contractor position in Rio de Janeiro for an oil and gas company.

Responsibilities

  • Maintains daily contact with the Well Site Leader (WSL) to define personnel and equipment schedules for time planning.
  • Updates the equivalent logistics system with information on the movement of personnel, equipment, solid bulk, and fluids.
  • Updates the operational status of the logistics system with information on vessel movement, obtains approval from the WSL, and sends it to the daily distribution list.
  • Updates the logistics system with information on vessel operations during the night, using feedback from the night shift deck crew.
  • Updates unloading and return documentation and distributes it to the day shift deck crew.
  • Sends a daily plan to the vessel for both shifts. If there is a need to transport Dangerous Goods (DG) on the vessel's return, prepares the DG documentation and transfers it to the vessel.
  • Completes the daily cost spreadsheet and sends it to the Drilling Engineer.
  • Completes all documentation prior to the completion of vessel operations (Safety Data Sheet, return manifest, and waste transfer notes).
  • Obtains the mud analysis from the Mud Engineer and sends it, along with the documentation, to the vessel.
  • Monitors weather conditions for the vessel's next departure to verify that there are suitable weather conditions for operating the ship.
  • Completes deck planning to verify sufficient space on the platform to receive the cargo.
  • Sends loading instructions to the Supply Base team to verify that priority cargo is accessible (without selective collection). When there is transshipment from the platform, verifies available space.
  • Determines the specific loading order for the platform to collect the casing pipes in the correct sequence.
  • Maintains contact with the Drilling Engineer for the deck layout in casing loading (slick and centered) to verify the correct collection sequence on the platform.
  • Maintains contact with the Platform Stability section for any Variable Deck Loading (VDL) issues, which determines what can be collected on the platform.
  • Maintains contact with the Mud Engineer for all bulk loadings, considering pit space, which may be limited on the platform.
  • Monitors the availability of empty buckets for ship and bucket operations, as this impacts VDL; it calculates the number of full containers for VDL (Very Daily Load) and replaces full containers with empty ones to maintain availability on the platform.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in offshore logistics, specifically in offshore oil and gas operations.
  • English advanced
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Kabal (Wellit).
  • In-depth knowledge of deepwater drilling and completion operations, associated equipment, common suppliers, platform management on a mobile offshore drilling unit, and logistics involved in performing well work.

Descrição da vaga

Desafios estratégicos

O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo.

Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio.

Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps.

Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário.

Atuação de Arquitetura

A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução.

A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa.

Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio.

A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA.

Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia.

O que a área te oferece

  • Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia
  • Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia
  • Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa

Posição de Arquitetura de Dados & IA

Esta posição irá ajudar a evoluir a arquitetura fundacional de dados & IA da Globo, que habilita os workloads de analytics, machine learning, generative AI e agentic AI.

Modelo de trabalho

Híbrido (RJ ou SP)

Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo.

  • Formação em andamento ou concluída em áreas quantitativas

  • Diferenciais: noções de Git, modelagem dimensional (fato/dimensão), conceitos de governança/LGPD

Competências Técnicas

title: Manager, Access Management Cluster
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

The Position

Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brasil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well-planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites.
  • Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution.
  • Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings.
  • Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues.
  • Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions.
  • Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar.
  • If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.
  • Football access management knowledge.
  • FIFA access management knowledge is a plus.
  • Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.
  • Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

Experience

  • Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage.
  • Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation.
  • Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment.
  • Single-sport, multi-venue event experience.
  • Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations.
  • Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure.

Requirements

description:
Job Description

Como definir o Branding da Beep? “Guardiões da marca e do Verde Beep”.

No dia a dia, as responsabilidades vão muito além do cuidado com a cor: a área cuida da integridade da marca, do tom de voz e das estratégias de comunicação, construindo a nossa reputação no mercado. Isso se reflete nas campanhas de Marketing, nas redes sociais, nos materiais criados para diferentes públicos (médicos, influenciadores, colaboradores etc.), na identidade visual da sede e de cada hub regional. É muita coisa? Sim, mas somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos e estamos em um ambiente leve e cheio de parceria!

O(a) Analista de Design pleno será responsável por toda identidade visual da Beep em todos os pontos de contato com o público. Essa pessoa será a guardiã do nosso brandbook, responsável por garantir consistência visual, criatividade e excelência nas entregas, com olhar estratégico, técnico e sensível ao detalhe.

Mais do que apenas executar: esperamos alguém que pensa a marca visualmente, proponha soluções e esteja de olho em tendências, como aplicação da AI na área.

Responsibilities and Assignments

  • Garantir a aplicação e evolução da identidade visual da marca, de acordo com o brandbook da Beep;
  • Criar peças para diferentes canais e formatos: social media, CRM, e-mail, mídia paga, materiais impressos, apresentações, comunicações internas, etc;
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de conteúdo como Planejamento, Social media, Growth, Produto e Eventos para desenvolver materiais criativos e estratégicos;
  • Explorar ferramentas de AI generativa para prototipagem, mockups e soluções visuais inovadoras;
  • Colaborar com o time de branding na construção de guidelines, templates e sistemas de identidade visual reutilizáveis;
  • Apoiar e orientar outros designers quando necessário.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Domínio avançado das ferramentas Adobe (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign);
  • Experiência com identidade visual e sistemas de marca;
  • Portfólio com projetos consistentes de branding e comunicação multicanal;
  • Diferencial ter experiências em motion design (After Effects, Premiere ou similares);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de AI aplicadas ao design;
  • Capacidade de lidar com demandas simultâneas com organização e autonomia;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para justificar decisões de design com embasamento técnico e estratégico.

Additional Information

  • Ter trabalhado com marcas do setor de saúde, tecnologia ou inovação;
  • Experiência com branding para produtos digitais;
  • Familiaridade com noções de UX/UI;
  • Conhecimento básico de HTML e desenvolvimento web;
  • Participação em processos de evolução de identidade visual.

title: Sr Sales Account Manager
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

The Senior Sales Account Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth through the sale of AspenTech software solutions and professional services. This is a customer-facing, individual contributor role that requires a highly self-motivated professional with strong business acumen, industry expertise, and consultative sales skills. In this role, you will manage and grow a portfolio of assigned customer accounts by identifying opportunities, positioning value-driven solutions, and expanding existing relationships. The Senior Sales Account Manager partners closely with cross-functional teams to develop account strategies, address complex client needs, and successfully close strategic opportunities. Success in this role is measured by the ability to renew, upsell, and expand business while deepening long-term customer relationships.

Your Impact

  • Developing business within an assigned region and upselling consulting services directly to assigned customer accounts.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to formulate client strategies, manage clients and bring to closure strategic client opportunities.
  • Account and relationship development and management, at all levels in the customer organization.
  • Articulate solution business value to customers and leads solution development efforts that best address customer needs whilst coordinating the involvement of all necessary company personnel including support, service and management resources in order to meet account performance objectives and customers' expectations.
  • Demonstrate understanding of the customer's business priorities and initiatives. Discuss relevant trends and priorities integrating industry knowledge and solution knowledge.
  • Have complete understanding of current usage of AspenTech software applications, white space and competitive software usage within the Account.
  • Overall strategic account plan, Opportunity Winning Plan, Competitive Displacement Plan and Pipeline Development Plan.
  • Respond to RFPs, Bid preparation, follow-up, negotiation and closing of sales.
  • Provide sales and executive management with account updates, sales forecasts, etc.
  • Achieve quarterly and annual sales quota.
  • Accurately forecast deals for the quarter and future quarters.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Bilingual: Portuguese and English
  • Minimum of 5 years software sales experience or Industry experience in a consultative selling role.
  • Strategic sales thinker - the candidate must be able to see how existing customer solutions can be repeated and leveraged within an industry sector.
  • Demonstrated track record in solution sales with multi-year achievement against personal quota.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Self-discipline and motivation with the ability to set goals that exceed the expectations of the company or manager.
  • Geosciences industry knowledge. Like, geoscience software products and services.
  • Travel is expected 25%-50% of time

title: Gas & Power Risk and Market Analyst (Montevideo Regional Office)
description:
Trafigura Group is currently growing its power trading capabilities in short-term and intraday markets in addition to established Geneva power trading desk. Therefore, we are seeking a highly motivated and experienced middle officer to join our Deals Desk team in Montevideo.

The Deals Desk is a middle office team providing market and risk analysis globally. The team’s primary responsibilities revolve around monitoring all elements of the risk and exposures related to commercial activity and report it directly to the Management Board on a daily basis.

As a Gas & Power Deals Desk Analyst, you will play a meaningful role in providing risk oversight to both new and established Latin American power and gas trading desk activities in Brazil, Argentina, Bolivia from our Montevideo office and will collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams to ensure all exposures and PnL are accurately captured and reported.

This role will be based in the Montevideo regional office.

Key responsibilities

  • Day to day reporting of physical and financial trading exposures and PnL across different entities.
  • Ensuring accurate and complete capture of trades and providing oversight and assistance for new product set‑up and testing.
  • Ensuring management are kept informed of key risks and activities of the trading desk.
  • Collaboration with other deals desk colleagues across locations.
  • Communicate with relevant Trafigura departments to help set up and maintain control processes and produce necessary reports: traders, operations, compliance, risk, accounting

Required qualifications

  • Technical knowledge and experience in power and gas markets.
  • Knowledge of physical and financial power trade life cycles.
  • Familiar with working on third party ETRM systems.
  • Previous work experience working with Allegro systems is a plus.
  • Knowledge of trade valuation concepts such as MtM, Accrual accounting.
  • Fluency in English, intermediate or equivalent to B2 is required.
  • Fluency in Spanish, advanced or equivalent to C2 is a must.

Preferred qualifications

  • Strong written and verbal communication. Professional, concise and accurate communication skills
  • Good market knowledge
  • Numeral literacy good attention to detail to complete the daily processes
  • Ability to be flexible and work to deadlines and under pressure
  • Open personality with energy and drive
  • Organized and diligent

Department overview
